question: Which complete upstream modules and attention heads causally write the fresh v21 tense change into the exact M11 bilinear writer state, and do those writes selectively cause the answer change?
evidence_status: Prospective full-population causal atlas registered after v21 native capability and the sealed v20 H/R branch, but before any v21 intervention outcome. Weight capability nominates interfaces; this experiment measures causal use.

searched: all temporal is/was complete-module, complete-head, greedy, H/R, response-tensor, and weight-interface records
the v15 all-layer module atlas and attention 8/9/11 head atlas
the v20 exact H/R state and scalar-gain crossfits
collision_audit.known_results: v15 found material attention modules 8/9/11 and heads L8H1/L9H1/L9H4/L11H3, but its later unconditional greedy search had no small selective prefix. Weight-only v17 scoring ranked L9H4 and L7H7 first among a six-head bank but did not separate the whole causal bank from its remainder. The new H/R result says readers are stable while the writer has six non-additive construction-by-direction states; a global writer, reader, product, or joint strength model fails held-out.
collision_audit.novelty: No prior experiment patches every complete upstream module and every head feeding M11 on a history-disjoint corpus while simultaneously measuring the exact nonlinear M11 writer-state response, target behavior, and P/C leakage. This is not a rerun of the unconditional v15 greedy search.

population.rows: All 64 frozen v21 rows: 16 each A1, A2, P, and C, in builder order; no outcome-dependent row selection.
population.target: A1 and A2 jointly, with their two directions retained in per-cell reports.
population.controls: P is same-answer tense paraphrase and C is the unrelated canonical control; both are patched identically to targets and never used to fit a component.

writer_branch_binding.reason: A/P reader cross-contraction keeps the target sign, swapping A/P writers flips it; held-out reader states are stable while writer states are not.
writer_branch_binding.state_model: Retain six construction-by-direction H/R cells. Do not impose an additive H hierarchy or a global gain scalar.
writer_branch_binding.scope: Only sites upstream of the MLP11 input are eligible: input embedding response; complete attention responses at layers 0 through 11; and complete MLP outputs at layers 0 through 10. MLP11 itself and all later modules are downstream of the writer boundary.

interventions.module_singletons: Patch the full donor response, through each row's semantic endpoint, at each of 24 eligible sites: input, attention 0..11, and MLP 0..10. Attention module response is the complete nine-head pre-c_proj tensor, so it is exactly decomposable into head slices.
interventions.head_singletons: Patch each of all nine complete 128-dimensional heads independently at every attention layer 0..11: 108 prospectively exhaustive head arms. No head is selected by v15, weight norm, or v21 outcomes.
interventions.unions: Patch every eligible donor site jointly. Also self-patch every eligible base site jointly. The donor union must reconstruct the donor trajectory; if it does not, no localization claim is valid.
interventions.exact_writer_endpoint: Capture the native or patched MLP11 input x and compute H(x)=(x Left^T)*(x Right^T) with the literal checkpoint weights. For every arm compare H(x_arm)-H(x_base) with H(x_donor)-H(x_base) on target rows, without gradients, rank selection, or fitted rotation.
interventions.behavior_endpoint: At the semantic endpoint compute donor-answer minus donor-foil margin. Compare each arm's change from base with the native donor-base target change.
interventions.position_rule: Patch and score every valid position through the semantic endpoint; padding is excluded by the row mask.

metrics.target: For behavior and M11 writer state report concatenated signed projection, cosine, relative residual, and rowwise positive-direction fraction over A1+A2; also report all six panel-by-direction cells.
metrics.controls: For P and C separately report RMS arm movement divided by target native RMS for behavior and writer state. These are leak ratios, not projections onto a fitted complement.
metrics.ranking: Rank all modules and all heads by the minimum of absolute target behavior recovery and absolute target writer-state recovery after requiring target direction and both control leak bars. Report raw rankings too; no rank cutoff changes the atlas.
metrics.known_head_watch: Report L7H7 and L9H4 ranks because the zero-forward weight atlas ranked them first, but do not seed or restrict the exhaustive causal atlas with them.

predictions.pred_a_authority_population_hooks_closur: All hashes, 16x4 rows, site/head inventory, masks, and hook calls match; the all-site base self-patch is <=1e-4; the all-site donor union closes final margin, final residual, M11 input, and exact H to <=1e-4 relative/absolute tolerance; all metrics are finite; exactly 136 forwards and 8704 sequence evaluations execute.
predictions.pred_b_complete_upstream_union_is_select: The donor union has target behavior and writer-state signed recovery >=0.75, direction fraction >=0.90, and P/C behavior and writer leak ratios <=0.15.
predictions.pred_c_at_least_one_complete_module_is_a: At least one module singleton has target behavior and writer-state absolute signed recovery >=0.10, both direction fractions >=0.75, and every P/C behavior/writer leak ratio <=0.15.
predictions.pred_d_at_least_one_complete_head_is_a_s: At least one of 108 head singletons meets the same joint >=0.10 recovery, >=0.75 direction, and <=0.15 P/C leak bars.
predictions.pred_e_weight_ranked_heads_are_causally_: At least one of L7H7 or L9H4 is a selective head and at least one is in the top 12 exhaustive heads by the frozen joint score.

opposing_outcomes.localized_upstream_writer_head: A-E pass and at least one selective head has joint target recovery >=0.30. Promote complete heads to the v21 necessity/sufficiency intervention and weight-restricted tensor decomposition.
opposing_outcomes.distributed_upstream_writer_set: A/B pass, the union is selective, but no selective head reaches 0.30 or C/D/E fails. Freeze singleton scores, then run forward greedy composition and backward necessity; enumerate exact Shapley interactions only if the resulting shortlist has at most 12 routes.
opposing_outcomes.module_without_head_localization: A-C pass but D fails. Treat the attention module or MLP as the causal unit; do not infer a head from weight norm.
opposing_outcomes.upstream_union_not_selective: A passes but B fails. Stop this upstream family; do not widen or greedily overfit a union that lacks a selective total effect.
opposing_outcomes.invalid_instrument: A fails; do not score B-E.

post_atlas_weight_tensor_rule: For each causally live singleton or greedy set, restrict its literal checkpoint write operator to the frozen M11 writer subspace. Decompose that restricted operator by exact SVD/HOSVD and literal atoms first, then sparse/hierarchical coding only if reconstruction and component-bootstrap stability hold. Overlay v20/v21 activation occupancy without refitting the weight basis. A weight-supported but unoccupied mode is capability, not an active edge; an occupied but causally null mode is correlation.
